paragraphs: Unit: 11:1–24 (24 verses). Meccan by traditional label.

Alif Lām Rā. A Book whose signs are made firm, then detailed, from One Wise, Aware: that you worship none but God. I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good news. And that you ask forgiveness of your Lord, then turn to Him. He will give you a good enjoyment until a named term, and give every possessor of bounty his bounty. If you turn away, I fear for you the punishment of a great day. To God is your return. He is over all things powerful.

They fold their breasts to hide from Him. When they wrap themselves in their clothes, He knows what they keep secret and what they make public. He is Knowing of what is in the breasts. There is no creature in the earth but its provision is on God. He knows its settled place and its stored place. All is in a clear book.

He is the one who created the heavens and the earth in six days — and His Throne was upon the water — that He might test you which of you is best in work. If you say: you will be raised after death, those who disbelieve will say: this is only clear magic. If We delay the punishment from them to a counted community, they will say: what holds it back? The day it comes them it will not be turned from them, and what they used to mock will surround them.

If We let man taste mercy from Us then wrest it from him, he is despairing, thankless. If We let him taste favor after a harm has touched him, he will say: the evils have gone from me. He is exultant, boastful — except those who were patient and did righteous deeds. For them is forgiveness and a great wage.

Perhaps you would leave some of what is revealed to you, and your breast is straitened by it, because they say: why has a treasure not been sent down on him, or an angel come with him? You are only a warner. God is Trustee over all things.

Or they say: he has forged it. Say: bring ten sūras the like of it, forged, and call whom you can besides God, if you are truthful. If they do not answer you, then know that it has been sent down with God’s knowledge, and that there is no god but He. So will you submit?

Whoever wants this world’s life and its adornment, We pay them in full for their deeds in it, and they will not be shorted in it. Those are they who have nothing in the last but the Fire. What they worked in it is vain, and what they used to do is void.

Is one who is upon a clear proof from his Lord, and a witness from Him recites it, and before it the Book of Moses as a leader and a mercy — those believe in it. Whoever of the parties disbelieves in it, the Fire is his appointed place. So do not be in doubt of it. It is the truth from your Lord, but most of the people do not believe.

Who does more wrong than one who invents a lie against God? Those will be shown to their Lord, and the witnesses will say: these are they who lied against their Lord. The curse of God is on the wrongdoers, who bar from God’s path and seek it crooked, and they in the last are unbelievers. Those cannot escape in the earth, and they have besides God no friends. The punishment is doubled for them. They could not hear and they did not see. Those are they who have lost their selves, and what they used to invent has strayed from them. There is no doubt that in the last they are the worst losers.

Those who believe and do righteous deeds and humble themselves to their Lord — those are the companions of the Garden, abiding. The likeness of the two groups is as the blind and the deaf, and the seeing and the hearing. Are they equal in likeness? Will you not remember?

1–4 firm then detailed Book; worship none but God; warner and news; forgiveness then enjoyment to a term. 5 they fold breasts to hide. 6 every creature’s provision on God. 7 six days; Throne upon the water; test which is best in work. 8 delayed punishment. 9–11 mercy wrested then despair; favor after harm then boast — except the patient. 12 you might leave some of what is revealed; they want treasure or an angel; you are only a warner. 13–14 forged-charge: ten sūras like it; if they fail, know it was sent down with His knowledge. 15–16 this-world seekers: paid here, Fire there. 17 on a clear proof; witness from Him; before it the Book of Moses as imām and mercy. 18–22 inventors, barriers, doubled punishment, worst losers. 23–24 believers vs two groups as blind/deaf vs seeing/hearing.

Created heavens and earth in six days — and His Throne was upon the water — that He might test you which of you is best in work. Cousin of 7:54 / 10:3. The water-Throne clause is new in the walked creation file. Genesis 1:2 waters are formless deep, not a throne. Living snapshot only.

Perhaps you would omit some of what is revealed, breast straitened, because they say: why no treasure, why no angel. You are only a warner. God is Trustee over everything. Pole B: he is tempted to withhold; he is told his job is warning, not producing the demanded extra-sign.

They say he forged it. Bring ten sūras the like of it, forged, and call whom you can besides God. If they do not answer: know it was sent down with God’s knowledge, and there is no god but He. Will you submit? 10:38 was one sūra. 2:23 was a sūra. The number moves. Do not silent-harmonize into ‘always one.’ Walk the three figures. Challenge still not scored as a completed contest.
11:17 Book of Moses as imām and mercy

One on a clear proof from his Lord, a witness from Him recites it, and before it the Book of Moses as a leader (imām) and a mercy — those believe in it. Parties who disbelieve: Fire. Do not be in doubt of it. It is the truth from your Lord.

The Book of Moses is named as prior imām and mercy, in parallel with this Recitation’s proof-and-witness. That is another confirmation-cluster point (QCA-0001). It treats Moses’ Book as a standing guide, not as scrap.

packets.title: S011 Hud CP02 vv025-049
paragraphs: We sent Noah to his people: I am to you a clear warner, that you worship none but God. I fear for you the punishment of a painful day. The assembly of those who disbelieved said: we see you only a mortal like us, followed only by the lowest of us at first opinion, and we do not see you having over us any bounty. Rather we think you are liars.

He said: if I am upon a clear proof from my Lord and He has given me mercy made obscure to you — shall we compel you to it while you are averse? I do not ask you for a wage. My wage is only on God. I am not one to drive away those who believed. They are going to meet their Lord. Who would help me against God if I drove them away? I do not say I have the treasuries of God, nor that I know the unseen, nor that I am an angel, nor that God will not give good to those your eyes despise.

They said: you have multiplied dispute. Bring us what you promise. He said: only God will bring it if He wills. My counsel will not benefit you if God wants to send you astray. Or they say he has forged it. Say: if I forged it, my crime is on me; I am quit of yours.

It was revealed to Noah: none of your people will believe except those who already believed. Do not be distressed. Build the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration, and do not address Me concerning those who did wrong. They are to be drowned. Whenever an assembly pass him they mock. He said: if you mock us, we mock you as you mock.

Until Our command came and the oven boiled. Carry in it of every pair two, and your household — except those against whom the word has gone before — and those who believed. None believed with him except a few. Embark. In the name of God is its running and its mooring.

It runs with them in waves like mountains. Noah called to his son, who was in isolation: my son, embark with us and do not be with the unbelievers. He said: I will take refuge in a mountain that will protect me from the water. He said: there is no protector today from God's command except him on whom He has mercy. The wave came between them, and he was of those drowned.
It was said: earth, swallow your water. Sky, desist. The water subsided. The command was fulfilled. It settled on al-Judi. Away with the wrongdoing people.

Noah called: my Lord, my son is of my household, and Your promise is the truth. He said: O Noah, he is not of your household. He is a deed not righteous. Do not ask Me for that of which you have no knowledge. I admonish you lest you be of the ignorant. He said: I take refuge with You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. Unless You forgive me I will be of the losers.

It was said: Noah, go down in peace from Us and blessings on you and on nations from those with you. And nations We will give enjoyment, then a painful punishment will touch them. That is of the news of the unseen We reveal to you. You did not know it, you nor your people, before this. So be patient. The end is for the godfearing.

packets.title: S011 Hud CP03 vv050-068
paragraphs: Unit: 11:50–68 (19 verses). Hud to Ad; Salih to Thamud.

To Ad, their brother Hud: O my people, worship God. You have no god other than Him. You are only inventing. O my people, I ask you no wage for it. My wage is only on Him who originated me. Will you not reason? Ask forgiveness of your Lord, then turn to Him. He will send the sky on you in torrents and increase you in strength upon your strength. Do not turn away as criminals.

They said: O Hud, you have not brought us a clear proof. We will not leave our gods on your saying. We are not believers in you. We say only that some of our gods have smitten you with evil. He said: I call God to witness, and you witness, that I am quit of what you associate besides Him. So plot against me, all of you, and give me no respite. I have put my trust in God, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but He takes it by the forelock. My Lord is on a straight path. If you turn away, I have conveyed to you what I was sent with. My Lord will replace you with a people other than you. You will not harm Him anything. My Lord is Guardian over all things.

When Our command came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us, and We saved them from a harsh punishment. That was Ad. They denied the signs of their Lord, disobeyed His messengers, and followed the command of every obstinate tyrant. They were pursued by a curse in this world and on the Day of Standing. Ad disbelieved their Lord. Away with Ad, the people of Hud.

To Thamud, their brother Salih: O my people, worship God. You have no god other than Him. He produced you from the earth and settled you in it. Ask forgiveness of Him, then turn to Him. My Lord is Near, Responsive. They said: O Salih, you were among us one in whom hope was placed before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? We are in grave doubt of what you call us to.

He said: O my people, have you seen if I am upon a clear proof from my Lord and He has given me a mercy from Him — who would help me against God if I disobeyed Him? You would increase me only in loss. O my people, this is the she-camel of God, a sign for you. Leave her to eat in God's earth and do not touch her with evil, lest a near punishment take you. They hamstrung her. He said: enjoy in your dwelling three days. That is a promise not to be belied. When Our command came, We saved Salih and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us, and from the disgrace of that day. Your Lord is the Strong, the Mighty. The Cry took those who did wrong. Morning found them in their homes fallen prone. As if they had not flourished there. Thamud disbelieved their Lord. Away with Thamud.

50–52 Hud: tawhid, no wage, rain-and-strength offer if they turn. 53–54 no proof; we will not leave our gods; our gods have smitten you. 55–57 quit of associates; plot against me without respite; trust; every creature taken by the forelock; if you turn I have conveyed; He will replace you. 58–60 saved by mercy; curse in this world and the Standing; away with Ad.
